pages.text: Two cells run the portable radios: the $(l:radiocraft:radios/vhf_handheld)VHF handhelds$(/l), the $(l:radiocraft:radios/cb_radios)CB portable$(/l) and the $(l:radiocraft:radios/qrp_and_receivers)VHF receiver$(/l). The weather alert receiver runs on either.$(li)The $(item)Small NiCd Battery$() is rechargeable, in a desk charger or a charge controller.$(li)The $(item)Small Alkaline Battery$() comes full, cannot be charged, and is thrown away when flat.

pages.title: Changing cells
pages.text: In an inventory, click a cell onto the radio, or click the radio onto a cell. The new cell goes in and the old one comes back with whatever charge it had left. The VHF receiver takes its cell with $(thing)shift + right click$().$(br2)A flat alkaline comes back as a $(item)Dead Alkaline Battery$(). A desk charger does not charge a radio with an alkaline in it.

pages.title: Dead Alkaline Battery
pages.text: What is left of an alkaline cell once a radio has run it flat. It holds nothing and powers nothing. Smelt it in a furnace or blast furnace to get its steel can back as an iron nugget.
